run_evaluate_mri_reconstructions: run the evaluate module to compute MSE, NMSE, PSNR, and SSIM metrics on MRI reconstruction HDF5 files
run_mse_function: run the mse function to compute mean squared error between ground truth and predicted numpy arrays
run_nmse_function: run the nmse function to compute normalized mean squared error between ground truth and predicted arrays
run_psnr_function: run the psnr function to compute peak signal to noise ratio with an optional maxval parameter
run_ssim_function: run the ssim function to compute structural similarity index on 3D ground truth and prediction arrays
